subject: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep-dive & provision pool for FinTrac
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@fintrac.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep-dive & provision pool for FinTrac

Hi Maria —

Thanks again for the intro call this morning. Good to hear FinTrac's immediate priority is sub-second latency for the document ingestion path and predictable throughput during end-of-month reconciliation windows. Per our conversation, next steps I recommend:

- Lock a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with your engineering + infra folks (we'll cover request patterns, KV cache behavior, and a short demo of the autoscaling/burst flow).
- Align on expected steady-state qps and peak token-per-minute numbers so we can size a dedicated GPU pool for you.
- Share any compliance questions for Private deployment early (data residency / KMS).

Can you share 2–3 windows over the next 7 days that work for Maria, Ethan (CTO), and the ops team? Also if you have a short load profile (requests/sec, avg/95th token length) paste it into a reply — that'll let Ben draft an initial pool-provisioning checklist.

I attached a short mutual action plan and a provisioning checklist we typically use to speed up the sizing call.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0123
Email: tessa_morgan@redwood.com

Attachments: FinTrac_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.docx (docx, 82KB), provisioning-checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)

From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@fintrac.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@fintrac.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@fintrac.com>
Date: 2028-01-21T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep-dive & provision pool for FinTrac

Hi Tessa —

Appreciate the recap. We're aligned on objectives. Quick answers:

- Availability: Jan 23 (Tue) 10:00–11:30 PT or Jan 24 (Wed) 14:00–15:00 PT. Ethan can make the Jan 23 slot but not the 24th.
- Load profile (approx): steady-state 20–30 requests/sec, average prompt+response ~600 tokens, peak windows up to 120 req/sec for 10–15 minutes at month-end.
- Data residency: primary US region, but we'll need to confirm KMS integration requirements with security.

If Jan 23 works, go ahead and pencil it in and we'll route a calendar invite to Ethan and ops@. I've attached a one-page summary of the ingestion flow we discussed.

—Maria
VP Product | FinTrac
maria.gonzalez@fintrac.com

Attachment: fintrac-ingestion-summary.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@fintrac.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-21T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep-dive & provision pool for FinTrac

Thanks Maria — Jan 23 10:00 PT works for our team.

Quick ops notes so we can prepare:
- We'll draft a starter GPU pool recommendation assuming 30 req/sec steady, 120 req/sec 95th for short bursts, and avg 600 tokens. If you have distribution (p50/p95 prompt length) that helps.
- Can you confirm whether the month-end bursts require strict latency SLO (<=300ms p95) or if slightly higher p95 is acceptable during bursts?
- For KMS: if FinTrac uses AWS KMS/Customer-managed keys, please include a contact who owns key rotation/ARN access — we'll surface the integration checklist in advance.

I'll share a short runbook extract and provisioning checklist before the call. If there's anything else ops wants on the agenda (ingress auth, IP allowlisting, log retention) add it here and we'll slot it in.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep-dive & provision pool for FinTrac

Hi all —

Jan 23 at 10:00 PT is confirmed on our side. I've accepted the calendar invite; Ethan and the ops alias are included.

A few prep notes from our infra lead (copied to ops):
- We'll bring network diagrams and sample request traces (sanitized) to the call.
- KMS contact: Priya Anand (priyaa@fintrac.com) — she'll be available for the call.
- Latency SLO: target p95 <= 350ms during steady state; during month-end peaks we can tolerate up to 450ms p95 but would like to understand tradeoffs for cost vs quantization/batching.

Tessa / Ben — appreciate the runbook and provisioning checklist up front. Once you send those we'll circulate to our security contact.

Thanks,
—Maria

Attachments referenced: none in this reply.

P.S. ops@fintrac.com — thanks for joining; please add any questions to the shared doc here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FinTracPrep (we'll add traces there)
